title: docs: explain how to enable registry image deletion
body:
## Summary
- Document enabling delete on a distribution registry (env or config.yml)
- Clarify this is registry-server config, not Skopeo / storage.conf
- Note the common 405 / UNSUPPORTED failure and garbage-collect step
Fixes #463
## Test plan
- [ ] Read `docs/skopeo-delete.1.md` new section for clarity
- [ ] `make docs` and spot-check rendered `skopeo-delete.1`
